item.ptxt: Perform the work with the engine coolant temperature at 60°C or less.
Before removing fuel system parts, be sure to perform the fuel spill prevention procedure.
Even after the fuel spill prevention procedure, some pressure remains in the fuel line, so when disconnecting the fuel line, cover it with a shop rag etc. to prevent fuel from spraying.

s2.ptxt: Remove the rear floor service hole cover. (Drive Type FF)
Remove the rear floor service hole cover. (Drive Type 4WD)
Disconnect the fuel pump connector from the fuel suction tube assembly.
Start the engine.
After the engine stops by itself, turn the IG OFF.

atten4.ptxt: Lean malfunction DTCs "P0171/25" and "P0174/25" may be detected.

s2.ptxt: Crank the engine again and check that it does not start.
Remove the fuel tank cap and release the pressure in the fuel tank.
Disconnect the cable from the negative (-) battery terminal.
For the procedure, see
Connect the fuel pump connector to the fuel suction tube assembly.
Install the rear floor service hole cover with new butyl tape. (Drive Type FF)
Install the rear floor service hole cover with new butyl tape. (Drive Type 4WD)
Perform the fuel spill prevention procedure. (For the procedure, see "1. Fuel Spill Prevention Procedure")
Remove the fuel pipe clamp.
Disconnect the fuel tube. (For precautions, refer to )
Connect SST and the gauge.
Wipe off any spilled gasoline with a shop rag or similar.
Connect the battery negative terminal.
Connect SST (TaSCAN) to DLC3.
Operate the fuel pump following the screen display and measure the fuel pressure. (For the procedure, see "3. Fuel Pump Operation Inspection and Fuel Leak Inspection")

atten4.ptxt: If the fuel pressure is high, replace the fuel pressure regulator. If the fuel pressure is low, inspect the fuel hoses, connections, fuel pump, fuel filter and fuel pressure regulator.

s2.ptxt: Disconnect SST (TaSCAN) from DLC3.
Start the engine.
Measure the fuel pressure at idle.

atten4.ptxt: If the result is not as specified, inspect the fuel pump, fuel pressure regulator or injectors.

s2.ptxt: After disconnecting the cable from the negative battery terminal, remove SST and the fuel tube connector.
Connect the fuel tube. (For precautions, refer to )
Connect the fuel pipe clamp.

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Fuel Pump Operation and Inspect for Fuel Leaks

s2.ptxt: Fuel Pump Operation Check

s3.ptxt: Operate according to the screen display, select 'Active Test' - 'Circuit Relay' - 'ON', and check the fuel pump operation.

s2.ptxt: Fuel Leak Inspection

s3.ptxt: Check that there are no fuel leaks in the fuel system while fuel pressure is applied.

s2.ptxt: Connect SST (TaSCAN) to DLC3.
Start the engine, display the "Active Test" screen following the screen display, select "Power Balance", and perform one of "#1-#4".
Check the idle condition after injection is cut for the cylinder tested.

atten4.ptxt: Testing is possible for 1 cylinder at a time; multiple tests cannot be performed at once.
